summary: Comprehensive testing of Turkish Document Tracking System (Evrak Takip Sistemi) completed successfully. All core features including admin authentication, document management, user management, routing workflow, notifications, and activity logging are working correctly.

resolved_issues.issue: User ID field inconsistency in get_current_user function
resolved_issues.description: Function was setting user['_id'] instead of user['id'], causing 500 errors in notifications and other endpoints
resolved_issues.fix_applied: Changed user['_id'] = str(user['_id']) to user['id'] = str(user.pop('_id'))

passed_tests: Dashboard stats display with 4 stat cards (Total, Pending, In Progress, Approved)
User management CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
Document upload functionality with file handling
Document listing and filtering by status
Document routing to other users with notes
Document history/timeline view showing routing actions
Notification system with dropdown and bell icon
Role-based access control (admin vs user permissions)
Logout functionality with proper session cleanup
Document detail page with download functionality
Modal dialogs for upload, routing, and user management
Frontend UI integration (all major workflows tested)
